rationale: Bounded unpack plus FP64 BLAS uses physical throughput, workload and charged-capacity gates. Explicit generated/blas controls preserve paired ablations. Unknown or limited FP64 capability, smaller work or insufficient scratch keeps the generated kernel; no GPU model controls availability.
revisit_condition: Expand the work/capability domain only with independent-reference complete endpoint timings, warm/moved controls and bounded scratch/lifetime evidence; current measurements do not establish an optimum on unmeasured devices.
